nodes.label: Hardware & Edge AI Architecture Layer
nodes.rationale: Four-layer system comprising Hardware/Edge AI, Audio/Actuators, Backend/Storage, and Frontend Dashboard.

nodes.label: 40-Pin GPIO Hardware Mapping Specification
nodes.rationale: Defines wiring for BH1750 (I2C), LCD1602 (I2C), LED (Pin 11/GPIO17), Buzzer (Pin 13/GPIO27), and MAX98357A (I2S).

nodes.label: Upper-Body Pose Scoring Geometry
nodes.rationale: Evaluates shoulder tilt, neck incline, and torso alignment from 8 upper-body landmarks without hips or legs.

nodes.label: Balanced Focus Mode Alert Logic
nodes.rationale: Risk threshold set at score < 65, duration of 8 continuous seconds, and 45-second cooldown between voice reminders.

nodes.label: Natural AI Neural Voice Alert Architecture
nodes.rationale: Replaces robotic espeak-ng with synthesized Thai neural voice PCM wav playback over MAX98357A and HTML5 audio.

nodes.label: SQLite Database Schema & REST Endpoints
nodes.rationale: Samples table with 35-day pruning, alerts log, daily_summaries (365-day retention), and settings key-value store.
